Fix on the PR #1 branch by tightening the scanner rather than renaming the frozen packet field: (1) drop the bare quoted-identifier check at :51 or restrict it to string literals that also contain an SQL keyword (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/FROM/INTO/JOIN/TABLE), and (2) keep the SQL-context regex at :53. Alternatively walk the AST and flag ast.Constant table names only when they are arguments to execute/executemany or inside f-strings with SQL keywords, ignoring ast.Subscript slices. claim: The evidence page's diagnosis of the test_build_preflight error ('validates committed worker profiles against worker-profile-v1.schema.json, which rejects the properties ... that the committed payloads carry. Schema and payloads are out of sync') is wrong in its attribution. Only one payload, athena.v1.json, carries those five properties; it is a different protocol ('helios.build.athena-worker-profile/v1') that validates cleanly against its own committed schema, and all eight worker-profile-v1 payloads validate cleanly against worker-profile-v1. The actual defect is that build_doctor_report globs every *.json in build_control/worker_profiles and forces each through load_worker_profile / worker-profile-v1.
evidence: Validation matrix output: 'athena.v1.json | worker-profile-v1.schema.json | FAIL ... Additional properties are not allowed'; 'athena.v1.json | athena-worker-profile-v1.schema.json | PASS'; every other profile 'PASS' against worker-profile-v1. 'athena extra vs worker-profile-v1: [allowed_capabilities, allowed_output_protocols, forbidden_capabilities, instructions_sha256, state]'; 'athena missing required of worker-profile-v1: [adapter_protocol, allowed_task_purposes, allowed_tools, max_concurrency, plugins, roles, skills, transports]'; 'athena protocol: helios.build.athena-worker-profile/v1 | worker-profile-v1 const: helios.build.worker-profile/v1'. doctor.py:277-278: 'for profile_path in sorted(profiles_root.glob("*.json")): profile = load_worker_profile(profile_path, schemas)'. source_registry.py:669-675 loads the ATHENA profile by exact path with the ATHENA schema.
recommendation: Rewrite the evidence-page row: 'doctor.py globs worker_profiles/*.json and validates the ATHENA research profile (a different protocol with its own schema) against worker-profile-v1; neither schema nor payload is wrong, the loader's directory scan is.' Fix on the PR #1 branch by dispatching on the payload's protocol field (skip or separately report profiles whose protocol is not helios.build.worker-profile/v1), or by moving athena.v1.json out of the worker_profiles directory; extend test_doctor_reports_each_committed_profile... to assert how the ATHENA profile is reported. Note the error's first-line message lists only the 5 extra properties because SchemaRegistry.validate reports the first sorted error; 8 required properties and the protocol const also mismatch.

verdicts.checked: Reproduced the error with the full suite run (tools/helios_build/doctor.py:277-278 glob -> profiles.py:110 validate against worker-profile-v1.schema.json).
